name: AXM Capability Gap Workbench
actions: compare normalized requirements with a declared capability inventory
separate ready, degraded, unknown, optional-gap and blocked requirements
draft typed contracts for missing capabilities
download an explicit JSON gap report
summary: A local workbench for turning declared requirements and capability inventories into honest, typed gap reports.
notes: Exact identifier comparison only. The workbench never installs dependencies, grants permissions, lowers quality, persists inputs, promotes modules or treats declarations as runtime proof.
